# Role permissions

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_permissions_doc.py from
     libs/platform_common/platform_common/permissions_matrix.yaml. Don't edit by hand. -->

The Release 1 role table (BRD under ON-5). The Product Owner owns the cells; the YAML
file is the only copy in code. Every business route declares one permission with
`require(Permission.X)`, and the server refuses a role without it with the same
**404 "not found"** as an unknown business (ON-2). Only the log records the reason
(`role_denied`). Hiding a button in the UI is never the control.

| Permission | Role-table row | Owner | Admin | Billing | CA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `settings.edit` | Business settings and invoice prefix | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| `members.manage` | Invite, deactivate and reactivate members | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| `catalog.view` | Products and customers (view) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| `catalog.edit` | Products and customers | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| `documents.create` | Create and finalize invoices and credit notes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| `documents.mark_paid` | Mark an invoice paid | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| `uploads.create` | Upload marketplace reports | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| `returns.prepare` | Prepare and export returns, TCS check | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| `returns.lock` | Mark a period filed and lock it | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| `returns.unlock` | Unlock a period (reason required) | Yes | No | No | No |
| `audit.view` | View the audit log | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| `support.grant` | Grant time-limited support access | Yes | No | No | No |
| `jobs.view` | See the progress of the business's background jobs | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

- `members.manage`: An admin can't invite, change or deactivate an owner. Identity enforces this on the target member.
- `jobs.view`: Not a BRD row. LLD-0 §3.7 grants it to every role for its own business, since every role starts some job (an upload, a PDF, an export).

## Actions that need a reason

A blank or whitespace-only reason is refused (422 `reason_required`). The reason goes into the audit row.

- `returns.unlock`
- `members.deactivate`
- `members.reactivate`
- `documents.s34_override`
- `filing.accept_warning`
- `imports.changed_line_choice`

## Rules outside the table

- A caller who isn't an active member of the business gets 404 (`not_member`), the same
  as for a business that doesn't exist or a malformed ID.
- A support user under an owner's grant may only read (`*.view`); any other permission
  is refused (`support_no_grant`).
- An unknown role string gets no permissions.
- Identity's member, invitation and audit routes use this table too (`members.manage`,
  `audit.view`); the database allows only these four roles since the LLD-1 reshape.
